subject.title: fix(agents): inherit default agent model catalog for secondary agents

question: Should secondary agents inherit default-agent generated provider request config and headers for providers they do not configure, or should this bug be solved by per-agent discovery/bootstrap or an early actionable failure?
rationale: The code can implement any of these paths, but the right boundary decides how provider metadata and credential-adjacent headers may cross agent directories during upgrades.

options.title: Accept Gated Inheritance After Rebase
options.body: Land this direction only after the branch preserves current-main registry invariants and maintainers accept inherited-only provider metadata under per-provider local-wins gating.

options.title: Use Per-Agent Discovery Or Bootstrap
options.body: Replace read-through metadata inheritance with a path that generates or persists each secondary agent's own catalog state.

options.title: Fail Early With Guidance
options.body: Avoid fallback inheritance entirely and return an actionable setup error when a secondary agent lacks usable model rows.

recommendation.title: Accept Gated Inheritance After Rebase
recommendation.body: Land this direction only after the branch preserves current-main registry invariants and maintainers accept inherited-only provider metadata under per-provider local-wins gating.

likelyOwner.reason: The central agent runtime and plugin model catalog ownership history points to this route for the provider/auth boundary decision.
